# Christmas Lights USA

Product key: christmas-lights-usa
Canonical product: https://christmas-lights-usa.base44.app/
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/christmas-lights-usa/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/christmas-lights-usa/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- estimate a professional Christmas light project
- find holiday light installers near me
- submit a Christmas light installation request
- join a holiday lighting installer marketplace
- buy a Christmas light installation lead
- plan professional holiday lighting for my property

## Authority

public planning, project-intake and installer-marketplace discovery; installer assignment occurs only after authoritative payment verification where a paid lead is selected

## Commercial state

- Status: public_marketplace_offer
- Offer: Homeowner planning estimator · Free
- Offer: Homeowner project request · Free
- Offer: Installer lead unlock · $50 per selected lead when available
- Payment state: Installer lead assignment requires independent provider verification; synthetic or test transactions are not revenue

## Boundaries

- Christmas Lights USA is a marketplace and project-intake platform, not the contractor performing installation
- planning estimates are guidance rather than contractor bids or guaranteed final prices
- installer availability varies by market and season
- homeowner project submission is free and creates no obligation to hire
- private customer, installer, admin, payment-session and lead-contact data are not public

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
